routing_adjustment.note: Uncommitted safe work from the discontinued work package was audited and corrected; it is not represented as an independent review.

review.note: No independent reviewer is claimed for this Roadmap task. Completion is based on reproducible Acceptance evidence; the V3 version Exit review remains separate.

acceptance.channel_neutral_core: PASS: contracts and PostgresGatewayStore contain no Feishu SDK types; Feishu is registered through ChannelAdapter and unsupported capabilities fail explicitly.
acceptance.identity_and_namespace: PASS: channel/external actor/conversation mapping is application-owned; inbox and notification idempotency keys include channel namespace.
acceptance.durable_inbox: PASS: inbox insert and unique agent_task enqueue are one PostgreSQL transaction; 8-way concurrent duplicate delivery creates one task; conflicting replay fails closed; expired task lease is restart-reclaimed with a higher fencing token.
acceptance.outbox: PASS: channel-scoped durable enqueue, lease claim, at-least-once retry, exponential backoff, delivered/dead-letter states, conflicting replay rejection, and append-like per-attempt delivery records are tested.
acceptance.control_callback: PASS: only server-issued challenges can be consumed; unknown callbacks cannot self-register; actor, action, target ID/version/SHA-256, payload, expiry, and token are bound; row locking proves one effect under 8 concurrent clicks.
acceptance.feishu: PASS: official lark-oapi websocket event/card callback registration, protocol translation, HTTP notification construction, redacted configuration, and `futures-agent-os gateway run` entrypoint are implemented.
acceptance.truth_boundary: PASS: gateway persistence owns only identity, inbox/task, callback, outbox/delivery state and invokes an injected owner command in the same transaction; it has no Order, Fill, Position, RiskDecision, or Ledger writer.
acceptance.latency: PASS: 100 isolated PostgreSQL durable ingests p95=1.107ms and max=12.253ms; target p95 < 2000ms.

verification.result: PASS: uv lock, ruff format/check, mypy (143 source files), secret scan, 2 schema, 1 unit, 9 property, 599 contract tests, and health.
PASS: all non-PostgreSQL tests; 60 PostgreSQL tests skipped as designed without FAO_DATABASE_URL and proven separately above.

residual_risk: No live Feishu credentials were available. Provider connectivity and real external delivery remain deployment verification, while SDK construction and local protocol boundaries are covered.

At-least-once delivery may call Feishu before a crash prevents DELIVERED persistence; the stable SDK uuid/delivery key provides the required receiver-side idempotency rather than claiming cross-system exactly-once.
scope_excluded: V3-002 and later autonomous workflow/agent behavior
real-money trading and real order routing
